chunks: Say: "Perhaps some of what you wish to hasten is right behind you."

key_terms.تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ: You hasten / You seek to speed up

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the punishment disbelievers wanted to hasten?
ai.summary: In Surah An-Naml, this verse reassures the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) that the divine retribution demanded by the disbelievers is not delayed but rather 'close behind' them, emphasizing the immediacy of Allah's power. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a confirmation of the inevitability of the Hour, linking the specific punishment of the disbelievers to the broader eschatological signs. It serves as a comfort to the faithful, illustrating that divine justice, though sometimes perceived as delayed, is precisely timed and inescapable.
